_readme: S399 SkyRowan, 2026-10-16. Wave 5's curriQunet read of Berkeley City College found no program: the start page's scripts asked for catalog id 0, so the walk read an empty catalog (run 38935112500: 0 of 97 found). This read prints the calls the start page's scripts make and the host's own catalog list, so the reader's catalog-id choice can be fixed against what the host serves. Two page loads, no model call.

questions.catalog_id: Which catalog ids the start page's scripts request, and which catalogs the host's _getCatalogs list names (id, title, deleted or active), for the 2026-2027 catalog.
